changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0001. Create the application schema. Index review: no indexes, because this changeset creates no table. Performance note: schema creation is a metadata operation and does not scan or lock user data.
changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = N'app') EXEC(N'CREATE SCHEMA app AUTHORIZATION dbo');

rollback.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.schemas WHERE name = N'app') DROP SCHEMA app;
